protocol.function: loop period T → quantize ω_m = 2π·n_m/T (n_m ∈ ℤ⁺) → C∞ periodic wave field → 0 boundary pop at t=T→0

robustness.name: All 16 wave ribs retain exact t=T and t=0 closure under reverse visitation

good_fit: Seamless looping ambient ocean, flag, and foliage waves
Exporting pop-free WebM / GIF / Lottie background loops
Factored spatial-temporal trig evaluation across dense vertex grids
Teaching why ω·T must be an integer multiple of 2π
not_for: Loopy or Mobius text-to-video latent diffusion looping
Non-repeating chaotic fluid splashes and breaking waves
